title: Crackline Uganda
author: unknown
contents: A campaign in the likes of Half-Life's infamous mod "Crack-Life". It comes with a single level, that tells the player to play the vanilla game of HLM2 with the mods installed. What's the worst thing that could happen?

title: Epistle 1
author: Plank
contents: In this 1-level long campaign you're playing as CP-27:43 getting an order to find Mr. Porn Man in his porn house. What he finds there instead is beyond his paycheck.

Part of the infamous "Coomtaker" saga, which hasn't been uploaded to the Steam Workshop, but instead on The Workshop Labs' Discord server, since its ending crashes the game no matter which way you go.

title: 2k Act 1
author: Janja
contents: A single level by janja, starring Evan who invades an office complex of some sort.

Noticable on this level is the rather cryptic dialogue being l33t-speak Russian (don't know how else to describe it). That and an amazing animation of a car crashing into the building similar to the second boss of Hotline Miami.

title: Chopped
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring Richter, clearing out a subway station.
One noticable moment is the floor with the train moving in, as well as the small puzzle to open the gate.

title: Fatal Drive
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring a Spider masked vigilante, breaking out of a police station similar to Hotline Miami 2's "Final Cut", including a cute choreography to end the level.

title: Hard Trip
author: Janja
contents: Single level starring Jacket clearing out a subway station, featuring a floor inside of a moving train.

title: 2k Act 1 Part 2
author: Janja
contents: A single level heavily inspired by Hotline Miami 2's "No Mercy", starring Corey.

title: 2k Act 2 (Eng)
author: Janja
contents: A 5-level long campaign about "Sanja", a prisoner and the warden "Sergei", trying to get a hold of their life during the many riots of the facilty. We hope you like psycho prisoners.
Judging by the grammar of this campaign, it was originally in Russian and then roughly translated to English. It's a bit of a hard read, but it should be understandable with enough effort.

It's possible, that the last level's last cutscene bugs out and sends you back to the first floor instead of sending you to the score screen. Should that happen to you, we provided the outro of the last level as a compromise so that you don't have to replay the level all over again.

title: Cleaning
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign where the fans plan their next raid into a headquaters full of Russian mobsters. A nice level with the player chararcter switching to one of the fans every 2 floors (excluding Mark) and a very pretty layout.
The intro is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Dead Calls 2
author: Janja
contents: A 6-level campaign, which is a compilation of Martin, Corey and Richter levels with an easy to follow plot for each character, including a refined version of "2k Act 1 Part 2".
The plot is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Deadly Trick
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about a SWAT team storming a mansion, that has a ticking bomb deep inside. Apart from the visually stunning intro, the main attraction of this level is the bomb being an actual threat throughout the level, that will blow up the whole floor if you're not fast enough. Can you make it to the last floor and defuse the bomb in time?
To see the full dialogue, set the game's language to Russian so that the lines won't go over the screen.

title: Hot Arrival
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about the Son invading a Colombian hideout, similar to "Death Wish" from the main game, changing the playable character from the Henchman, Sasha (Pardo reskin) and the Son himself.

title: Deep Red Redux
author: SuitedFox
contents: SuitedFox's infamous 13-level long campaign, starring Jake Coalis, who's trying to get his revenge on those who tried to murder him.
Includes a music mod featuring various synthwave artists and custom weapon sounds.

title: Workshop War
author: SuitedFox
contents: A 12-level long campaign, in which Jake Coalis, or rather his author SuitedFox, go on an adventure to save the Hotline Miami 2 modding scene from the never ending wave of pardo shitposts.
Like Deep Red Redux, this one also comes with a music mod and custom weapon sounds.

title: Frostbite
author: thebasicbrick
contents: A 5-level long campaign set in Alaska 1984. Follow along Peter and his squad, as they are fighting off the Soviet military in their home land.
This one also comes with an altered music mod, that could break the game when playing a different level, as all the unused songs have been removed.

title: Snowblind
author: Plank
contents: A fan-made single level set in the universe of the Hunter trilogy. Here, you play as Simon clearing out a 3-floor building full of thugs and Bratva members.
While the level itself is competently made, it also serves as a time capsule on how Hunter's sprites used to look like compared to the current, more refined version of the trilogy.

title: Banger
author: b-idea
contents: A single level from the colaborative collection "Summer Of Rage", featuring 3 action packed floors with many summer-themed sprites and vibrant enemy and furniture recolors.
The level collection itself has a music mod, which is encouraged to be installed when playing the whole collection. You can find it at https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1822110263.

title: Politics
author: 1spiceyburgar
contents: Also known as "Coomtaker 3", this 4-level long campaign continues the aesthetics of the previous two entries both in gameplay and story. Follow the adventures of an unnamed policeman going through the many political struggles in Minnesota at the heat of the year 2020.
Taken down off the Steam workshop during their iffy policies on handling external links. Files and music wad were given by the author.

title: Fandom Adventures Part 1
author: Atlan
contents: A 12-level long shitpost campaign, starring Jacket, Manny, Richter, Son and many more characters digging through several fandoms, that ruin their reputation. Contrary to popular belief, the campaign has been discontinued a long time ago and a second part of the installment will never happen.

This campaign was made a long time ago and the author has moved on from its subject matter. He doesn't endorse any behaviour and beliefs in it, so please don't bother him with this campaign. Instead, check out his newer stuff like "Auto Angel", "Buried", "Wildstyle", "Fever" and "Moving Shadows". They're all publicly available on the workshop.

title: To the top
author: b-idea
contents: A spin-off level featuring Dennis from Wildstyle (or rather HLM1). This short, but stylish level features a set of unique encounters in closed corridors while also keeping the atmostphere of the original game.
One noticable feature are the yellow soft walls working just like in the original game, making this level as true to the original game as possible, thanks to the technical discovery they made.

title: Dust
author: b-idea
contents: B-idea's ambitious 1-level campaign set in a post-apocalyptic world. You're playing as a female merc, fighting monsters inside an abandoned subway station.

This campaign oozes in atmosphere with its beautiful spritework and light effects and is not holding back with its difficulty, featuring a tight arena section and a crushing boss fight with its OST mainly taken from Quake 3: Arena.

title: Fascio
author: dedsekret & xyfropunk
contents: A level initially made for the "Vinyl Violence" collection. Set in a city, where you're fighting off terorrists, who just bombed a subway station, all accompanied with competent spritework and thrilling enemy placement.

Noticable are the radical imagery used to present the enemy faction as well as the chosen track in the background. You can get the music mod from the official steam collection at https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2786920139.

title: JACKT WRKSHP EDTN
author: CrazyJaydon
contents: Jaydon's infamous shitpost campaign, solidifying the JACKT genre as the low effort shitposts in 8 compact and thrilling levels. Old and very outdated memes ahead. Play at you own risk!

title: Faded Act I
author: perforator
contents: Perforator's initial concept to what later became (or rather becomes) Revenant. This act covers the first 4 levels on how Alex gets involved into the life of crime in east europe, starting with a mysterious phone call and an ominous presence in his vivid dreams.
We recommend setting the game's language to Russian, as the dialogue goes over the screen if played in English.

title: Faded Act II
author: perforator
contents: The 4-level long sequel of Alex's life of violence, now heading to Belarus' capital Minsk, clearing out the Mafia while getting suspicious about his higher-ups.
Like its prequel, we recommend setting the game's language to Russian, as the dialogue goes over the screen if played in English.

title: Faded Act I (Rus)
author: perforator
contents: The Russian version of perforator's initial concept to what later became (or rather becomes) Revenant. This act covers the first 4 levels on how Alex gets involved into the life of crime in east europe, starting with a mysterious phone call and an ominous presence in his vivid dreams.
We recommend setting the game's language to Russian, otherwise the text will only say "%%%%%%".

title: Faded Act II (Rus)
author: perforator
contents: The Russian version of perforator's following 4-level long act on Alex's life of violence, now heading to Belarus' capital Minsk, clearing out the Mafia while getting suspicious about his higher-ups.
Like its prequel, we recommend setting the game's language to Russian, or otherwise the text will only say "%%%%%%".
